table-design.table-styles.styles.clear.note: U:quill/table_misc: takes the table's style off (table.clearStyle). Word's, not in wordcraft: not checked against upstream.

table-design.borders.line-style.note: U:quill/table_misc: table.pen: the line the Borders menu and the Border Painter draw with (None, single, double, dotted, dashed, dot-dash, thick, triple, wave). Word's, not in wordcraft (it sets a line style only in Modify Table Style): not checked against upstream.

table-design.borders.line-weight.note: U:quill/table_misc: table.pen: the weight the Borders menu and the Border Painter draw with (1/4 pt to 6 pt). Word's, not in wordcraft: not checked against upstream.

table-design.borders.pen-color.note: U:quill/table_misc: table.pen: the colour the Borders menu and the Border Painter draw with. Word's, not in wordcraft: not checked against upstream.

items.label: Theme Colors / Standard Colors / Recent Colors palette

table-design.borders.border-painter.note: U:quill/table_misc: table.borderPainter (wordcraft specs.rs): the table's borders drawn with the pen (a table.borders call), as wordcraft's does; Word turns a painting cursor on instead.

table-design.borders.borders.view-gridli.note: U:quill/table_misc: table.viewGridlines (wordcraft cmd/view.rs): the outlines of table cells, dashed and light, on screen only (the display list, never print or export).

table-layout.table.view-gridlines.note: U:quill/table_misc: table.viewGridlines (wordcraft cmd/view.rs): the outlines of table cells, dashed and light, on screen only (the display list, never print or export).

table-layout.alignment.cell-margins.note: U:quill/table_misc: table.cellMargins and dialog.tableCellMargins (wordcraft specs.rs, forms.rs): the table's default cell margins in points. Not offered: Allow spacing between cells and Automatically resize to fit contents (no engine upstream).

references.research.search.note: U:quill/references: hidden: Search (the Researcher's web search) needs an online service and has no engine upstream.

references.research.researcher.note: U:quill/references: hidden: references.researcher is catalogued upstream with no engine (it needs an online research service).

mailings.start-mail-merge.start-mail-mer.note: U:quill/mailings: hidden: the Step-by-Step Mail Merge Wizard pane has no upstream engine; the Mailings ribbon does each step (Start Mail Merge, Select Recipients, Insert Merge Field, Preview Results, Finish & Merge).

mailings.finish.finish-merge.print-docum.note: U:quill/mailings: mailings.printDocuments (wordcraft cmd/mailings.rs): the merge into a new document, as Finish & Merge makes it, and the Print page opened for it; dialog.printRecords asks which records (All, Current record, From and To).

mailings.finish.finish-merge.send-email-.note: U:quill/mailings: hidden: Send Email Messages needs a mail account and has no upstream engine (the merge makes documents, never mail).

view.dark-mode.switch-modes.note: U:quill/view: view.darkMode (wordcraft cmd/view.rs): the pages drawn dark with light text, on screen only; never printed or exported.

view.window.full-screen.note: U:quill/view: view.fullScreen (wordcraft cmd/view.rs, F11): the window fills the screen through the window service (never in test runs); Esc leaves it.

view.macros.macros.pause-recording.note: U:quill/view: upstream's recorder has no pause; hidden.

developer.controls.group.group.note: U:quill/developer: hidden with Group: grouping content controls is not upstream (no engine).

developer.controls.group.ungroup.note: U:quill/developer: hidden with Group: grouping content controls is not upstream (no engine).

outlining.master-document.show-document.note: U:quill/outlining: hidden: master documents and subdocuments have no upstream engine (a document is one story here).

outlining.master-document.collapse-subdo.note: U:quill/outlining: hidden: master documents and subdocuments have no upstream engine (a document is one story here).

chart-format.arrange.wrap-text.edit-wrap.note: U:quill/chart: hidden: wrap points are not translated (Tight and Through use the object's rectangle).

chart-format.arrange.wrap-text.move-with.note: U:quill/chart: hidden: arrange.moveWithText needs the laid-out anchor offsets (see core/quill/commands/objects/arrange.mjs).

chart-format.arrange.wrap-text.fix-posit.note: U:quill/chart: hidden: arrange.moveWithText needs the laid-out anchor offsets (see core/quill/commands/objects/arrange.mjs).

chart-format.arrange.align.use-alignment.note: U:quill/chart: hidden: alignment guides are a drag aid of the page view, which does not draw them.
